water_source: Spring - H. Noel, U. S. Forest Service
notes: Faint typescript. Page corner reads 'STATION 131' (report's own numbering or page number, not a USGS station number). No place, county or state printed. 27 dated rows: 27 discharges (second-feet and gallons per minute counted once) + 20 temperatures (1949: 6, 1950: 10, 1951: 4; blank for the first five rows, Dec. 20 1949 and Nov. 15 1950). Some temperature cells are faint, so the count may be off by one or two; seconds of the latitude read as 10. Times of day and the altitude in the heading not counted.
